headlines.title_en: Hong Kong SFC tightens rules on misleading titles to reduce the risk of investor misjudgment
headlines.summary_en: On November 6, the Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) of Hong Kong published a consultation conclusions paper on further restricting the use of misleading names by unregulated entities to protect investors, with the proposed amendments receiving broad market support. The SFC said it will expand the list of restricted titles and establish a mechanism for updating the list more quickly, while extending regulatory coverage to the virtual asset sector, reducing investors' misjudgments caused by institution names at the source and shoring up investor protection.

headlines.title: 利用俄被冻结资产 乌克兰据称获得近500亿美元支持
headlines.summary: 据俄罗斯方面7日消息，根据乌克兰财政部发布的数据进行计算，过去两年间，利用被冻结的俄罗斯资产的收益，乌克兰已获得494亿美元资金支持。仅2026年，乌克兰就获得105亿美元的资金支持，这都来源于被冻结俄资产的收益。

headlines.title_en: Using frozen Russian assets, Ukraine is reportedly receiving nearly $50 billion in support
headlines.summary_en: According to Russian sources on the 7th, calculations based on data released by Ukraine's Ministry of Finance show that over the past two years Ukraine has received $49.4 billion in funding support from the proceeds of frozen Russian assets. In 2026 alone, Ukraine received $10.5 billion in funding support, all derived from the proceeds of frozen Russian assets.

headlines.title_en: GM executive: remains optimistic about the development prospects of China's new energy vehicles
headlines.summary_en: Rui Xu, global senior vice president of General Motors and president of GM China and Asian markets, said recently at the 9th China International Import Expo that the expo provides a platform for GM to engage with Chinese consumers and showcase the results of its cooperation with China. China's auto market is highly innovative, with fast-paced product development and iteration, bringing important opportunities for the company's innovation and cooperation, and GM remains bullish on the prospects for developing new energy vehicles in China. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title: 中白工业园铁路场站正式投运
headlines.summary: 位于白俄罗斯明斯克郊区的中白工业园GREATPORT多式联运铁路场站6日正式开业投运，首列“麦穗”号和“矢车菊”号中欧集装箱班列从场站发往中国。GREATPORT是现代化物流综合体，该项目由中白工业园居民企业亚欧陆运通道股份有限公司投资运营，具备集装箱班列集结、发运和接收能力，可处理进出口及过境等货流任务。场站设计年吞吐量为18万标箱，未来计划提升至50万标箱。项目已建成4条铁路线及系列配套功能设施。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: The China-Belarus Industrial Park railway station is officially put into operation
headlines.summary_en: The GREATPORT multimodal railway terminal in the China-Belarus Great Stone Industrial Park on the outskirts of Minsk, Belarus, officially opened and began operations on the 6th, with the first China-Europe container trains, the "Wheat Ear" and the "Cornflower," departing from the terminal for China. GREATPORT is a modern logistics complex invested in and operated by Eurasia Land Transport Corridor Co., Ltd., a resident enterprise of the industrial park. It has the capacity to assemble, dispatch and receive container trains and can handle import, export and transit cargo flows. The terminal is designed with an annual throughput of 180,000 TEUs, with plans to raise it to 500,000 TEUs in the future. The project has completed four railway lines and a series of supporting facilities. (Xinhua News Agency)
